title: data set: gate data — failure kinds, flake policy, cannot-run predicate, mapping schema
description: Round 4 of #598: contract items 4-7. The failure-kind enumeration completed with abort and not-collected (per-kind validity: which kinds constitute a valid executed red, which are the neither-red-nor-green recorded states); the flake-resistance repetition number and per-test aggregation rule covering pin runs and the suite delta alike; the cannot-run predicate's command binding and exit-and-timeout semantics (the lawful discriminator's mechanical check for the broken-verification-surface form); the mapping schema for relocation-as-fix with the adopted report-set default confirmed or overridden (the contract authored the fixture list against the default; overriding retires the cfg-vanished degradation). All numbers and the default confirmation are operator-owned. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: quality-engineer (gate mechanics are that lens's exact concern).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR ADOPTION 2026-07-20, all four blocks as proposed: the 10-member failure-kind enumeration with the red-validity split (five valid executed reds; compile-failure conditional on the validator-approved declaration; four neither states per the pin doctrine); flake policy 3 runs with same-kind unanimity for red, all-pass for green, mixed as the flaky recorded state; the cannot-run predicate bound to the declared workspace test command with no-report-or-zero-collected semantics and a 600s recorded timeout; and the mapping schema with the report-set default CONFIRMED — the cfg-vanished degradation and its fixtures stand as the ratified contract authored them. Data Engineer pass under the session's loaded lens: no new findings — pair rule followed, all flow-map values with punctuation quoted (the round-2/3 lesson applied at authoring), red-validity fork pinned by schema enum, cross-set constraint declared (none needed beyond kind uniqueness — this set is self-contained). Quality Engineer validator note for the spec-review round: the same-kind unanimity rule's interaction with kind-migrating flakes (a test alternating panic/timeout) lands in the flaky state by construction — flagged as the branch the round should scrutinize.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: the set landed as the pair with all four adoptions applied. Evidence: the round-4 commit, mdatron verify clean at first attempt.
